results.title: Extension of the Suspension of Expansion of End-User Controls for Affiliates of Certain Listed Entities
results.abstract: The Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS) is extending the suspension of the interim final rule (IFR), "Expansion of End-User Controls to Cover Affiliates of Certain Listed Entities." The suspension was set to end November 9, 2026. This final rule extends the suspension through January 10, 2027.
